values.meaning: duration during which next attack is empowered
values.quote: empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: Tumble resets Vayne's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Tumble {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vayne's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup, but Vayne cannot attack until the dash animation completes.
mechanics.quote: empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 3 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: The basic attack portion of Tumble's damage is tagged as basic damage and spell damage, while the bonus damage is tagged as spell damage only.
mechanics.quote: The basic attack portion of ''Tumble's'' damage is tagged as {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, while the bonus damage is tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the dash effect resolves, not on cast.
